summary: McGraw Hill, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, disclosing a Regulation FD press release and a conditional redemption notice. Wholly-owned subsidiary McGraw-Hill Education, Inc. intends to offer $500 million of senior secured notes due 2033 in a private placement, guaranteed by parent Mav Intermediate Holding II and certain subsidiaries. Proceeds, plus an $830 million first-lien term loan B due 2033 and a $150 million revolver extended to 2031, will redeem all outstanding 5.750% secured notes due 2028 and refinance the existing term loan. A $50 million voluntary prepayment is expected by September 30, 2026. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
